title: Reciprocal rank fusion
summary: Reciprocal rank fusion combines ranked lists without putting their scores on one scale.
body: Gordon V. Cormack, Charles L. A. Clarke, and Stefan Büttcher described reciprocal rank fusion at SIGIR 2009. The diary adds 1/(k+rank) across the BM25 list and the int8 cosine list, with k = 60.

sources.title: Cormack, Clarke, and Büttcher, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, SIGIR 2009
sources.author: Gordon V. Cormack, Charles L. A. Clarke, and Stefan Büttcher
